reasoning: Shows a stopwatch paired with an upward arrow, clearly communicating counting up elapsed time or increasing a time duration/timeout. It fits specific tasks around extending timeouts, building endurance hold times, or timing how long something takes, though plain stopwatch or clock icons cover much of the same ground.

pass1.ambiguity: Whether the up arrow means 'counting up' (stopwatch vs countdown) or 'more/longer time' (extending a limit) or 'faster pace'.
